text: To honor Evdos is to open both mind and heart. We do not fear honest questions. A question asked in humility is already a prayer.

Knowledge is not pride, and wisdom is not noise. The wise listen first, test their words, and speak what can heal, guide, or protect. Ylarus, God of Time, teaches that no truth worth knowing is rushed.
Ulrog is the God of Power, and his temptation is simple. He whispers, 'Rule first. Understand later.' He says, 'Take now. Reflect never.' Power without understanding soon becomes cruelty.

Evdos teaches another order: understand first, act with discipline, and govern your strength. Even a righteous act becomes foolish in haste. Knowledge without mercy grows cold, but power without knowledge grows blind.
In your homes, teach your children to read, to reason, and to remember. In your work, choose precision over haste and honesty over applause. In your conflicts, let truth speak before anger does.
If you must be strong, be strong in patience. If you must lead, lead by understanding. Walk from this temple as seekers of knowledge, not servants of domination.
Go in peace, children of Lastdenn. Choose the light of Evdos, God of Knowledge, and turn away from Ulrog, God of Power.
And that concludes this amazing sermon.
If you have any questions or would like to discuss anything further, please feel free to come see me after the service.
